name: The Mighty U'cha
label: Quest
description: The Mighty U'cha: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While you have been exploring Un'Goro, I have seen other things that a mighty hunter such as yourself would relish in. One such sight was a huge ape among the other gorillas to the north. You have been to that cave before, but this time, I wonder if you'll survive the encounter if you accept my task.

I call him U'cha, and he is one of the Earth Mother's greatest sons, of that you can be sure. Defeat U'cha and bring me his pelt. Do this, and I will defend your right to call yourself a great hunter.

clips.title: Progress
paras: U'cha... The beast was magnificent. Huge and red, with teeth the size of daggers. His arms as thick as tree trunks, and as fast as any mountain lion I have ever laid eyes upon. You should consider yourself lucky to find such a test of bravery--my people would go generations without seeing such a creature.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. I am pleased. You have done a great thing here today.
U'cha was one of the greatest apes I had ever seen. The fact that you have bested his strength speaks well of your own strength... And courage.
It is only fitting that I give you this as a sign of respect. You have earned it.
